chapterInfo.content:
24
Yoas nneyɛɛ pa
1 # 2 Ah 12 Yoas dii mfeɛ nson na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduanan wɔ Yerusalem, na ne na din de Sibia a ɔfiri Beer-seba. 2Na Yoas yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada berɛ no so nyinaa. 3Na Yehoiada waree yerenom baanu maa no, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
4Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ. 5Na ɔboaboaa asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ no ano hyiae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfiri adi nkɔ Yuda nkuro so, na monkɔgyegye dwetɛ mfiri Israel nyinaa nsam, na wɔde apempam mo Nyankopɔn fie no daa afe; na mo deɛ, momma mo ho nyɛ hare asɛm yi mu. Nanso Lewifoɔ no ho anyɛ hare. 6#Eks 30.12-13 Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na womma Lewifoɔ no nnye Yuda ne Yerusalem toɔ a AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israel badwa no hyɛ maa adanseɛ ntomadan no? 7#2 Be 22.3-4 Na Atalia, ɔbɔnefoɔ no mma ahyɛne Nyankopɔn fie no mu, na AWURADE fie akronkronneɛ nyinaa nso, wɔahwere ama Baalim. 8Na ɔhene no ka maa wɔpamm adaka baako, na wɔde sii AWURADE fie pono ano wɔ adihɔ, 9#2 Be 24.6 na wɔpaee no Yuda ne Yerusalem sɛ wɔmfa Nyankopɔn akoa Mose toɔ a ɔde too Israel so wɔ ɛserɛ so no mmrɛ AWURADE. 10Na mmapɔmma no nyinaa ne ɔman no nyinaa ani gyee. Na wɔde ba bɛguu adaka no mu ara kɔsii sɛ ɛyɛɛ ma. 11Na berɛ biara a Lewifoɔ no bɛhunu sɛ sika adɔɔso wɔ adaka no mu no, wɔde brɛ wɔn a ɔhene ahyɛ sɛ wɔnhwɛ soɔ no; ɔhene twerɛfoɔ ne deɛ ɔsɔfo panin no ahyɛ sɛ ɔnhwɛ soɔ no ba bɛhwie firi adaka no mu, na wɔma so sane de kɔsi ne sibea. Saa na na wɔyɛ no da biara, na wɔboaboaa sika bebree ano. 12Na ɔhene ne Yehoiada de maa wɔn a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie som adwuma no, na wɔde bobɔɔ aboɔpaefoɔ ne adwumfoɔ paa sɛ wɔnsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ, ne dadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adwumfoɔ nso, sɛ wɔmmiamia AWURADE fie no mu. 13Na wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no yɛe, na pempam adwuma no kɔɔ so wɔn nsam, na wɔde Nyankopɔn fie no sii hɔ maa no yɛɛ yie na ɛyɛɛ den. 14Na wɔwieeɛ no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ baa ɔhene ne Yehoiada anim, na wɔde yɛɛ nnoɔma maa AWURADE fie, ɔsom ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho nnoɔma ne nkoraa ne sika ne dwetɛ nnoɔma no. Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie daa daa Yehoiada berɛ so nyinaa.
15Na Yehoiada bɔɔ akora, na wanyini pa ara no, ɔwui. Na ɔwuiɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha aduasa. 16Na wɔkɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu, ahemfo no nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii asɛmpa Israel ne Onyankopɔn ne ne fie no ho.
Yoas wae firi Nyankopɔn ho
17Na Yehoiada wuo akyiri no, Yuda mmapɔmma ba bɛkotoo ɔhene no. Ɛnna ɔhene no tiee wɔn. 18Na wɔgyaa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn fie, na wɔkɔsomm Asera nnua ne ahoni no. Na wɔn asodie yi nti abufuo baa Yuda ne Yerusalem so. 19Na ɔsomaa adiyifoɔ maa wɔbaa wɔn mu sɛ wɔmmɛsane wɔn mmra AWURADE nkyɛn, na wɔdii wɔn adanseɛ, nanso wɔantie.
20Na Nyankopɔn honhom baa Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada ba Sakaria so, na ɔkɔgyinaa soro ɔman no anim ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Onyankopɔn seɛ nie: Adɛn nti na moto AWURADE mmara nsɛm? Na ɛrensi mo yie. Sɛ moagya AWURADE yi, ɔno nso agya mo. 21#Mat 23.35; Heb 11.37 Na wɔpam ne tiri so, na wɔkɔsii no aboɔ, sɛdeɛ ɔhene hyɛeɛ no AWURADE fie abannwa so. 22Na Ɔhene Yoas ankae adɔeɛ a Sakaria agya Yehoiada de yɛɛ no no, na ɔkumm ne ba no. Na ɔrewuo no, ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE nhwɛ na ɔntɔ so were.
Yoas asotwe ne ne wuo
23Na afe no awieeɛ no, Siriafoɔ dɔm tu baa ne so, na wɔbaa Yuda ne Yerusalem, na wɔbɛsɛee ɔman no mmapɔmma no nyinaa firii ɔman no mu, na wɔn asadeɛ no nyinaa, wɔde kɔmaa Damasko hene. 24Na nnipa kakraa bi na Siriafoɔ dɔm de baeɛ, nanso AWURADE de dɔm kɛseɛ pa ara hyɛɛ wɔn nsa, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔagya AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no. Na Yoas nso, wɔne no dii atemmusɛm. 25#2 Be 21.20 Na wɔfirii ne so sii mu kɔeɛ, na wɔgyaa no apirakuro bebree mu, na ne nkoa pamm ne tiri so, Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada mma no mogya nti, na wɔkɔkumm no ne mpa so, na ɔwui. Na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu, nanso wɔansie no ahemfo no asieeɛ. 26Na wɔn a wɔpamm ne tiri soɔ no nie: Sabad, Amonni baa Simeat ba ne Yehosabad, Moabni baa Simrit ba. 27Na ne mma no ne ɛtoɔ dodoɔ a wɔgyee no no, ne Nyankopɔn fie asiesie no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Ahemfo Nwoma Nkyerɛaseɛ no mu. Na ne ba Amasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.

Yoas dii mfeɛ nson na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduanan wɔ Yerusalem, na ne na din de Sibia a ɔfiri Beer-seba. Na Yoas yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada berɛ no so nyinaa. Na Yehoiada waree yerenom baanu maa no, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ. Na ɔboaboaa asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ no ano hyiae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfiri adi nkɔ Yuda nkuro so, na monkɔgyegye dwetɛ mfiri Israel nyinaa nsam, na wɔde apempam mo Nyankopɔn fie no daa afe; na mo deɛ, momma mo ho nyɛ hare asɛm yi mu. Nanso Lewifoɔ no ho anyɛ hare. Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na womma Lewifoɔ no nnye Yuda ne Yerusalem toɔ a AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israel badwa no hyɛ maa adanseɛ ntomadan no? Na Atalia, ɔbɔnefoɔ no mma ahyɛne Nyankopɔn fie no mu, na AWURADE fie akronkronneɛ nyinaa nso, wɔahwere ama Baalim. Na mmapɔmma no nyinaa ne ɔman no nyinaa ani gyee. Na wɔde ba bɛguu adaka no mu ara kɔsii sɛ ɛyɛɛ ma. Na berɛ biara a Lewifoɔ no bɛhunu sɛ sika adɔɔso wɔ adaka no mu no, wɔde brɛ wɔn a ɔhene ahyɛ sɛ wɔnhwɛ soɔ no; ɔhene twerɛfoɔ ne deɛ ɔsɔfo panin no ahyɛ sɛ ɔnhwɛ soɔ no ba bɛhwie firi adaka no mu, na wɔma so sane de kɔsi ne sibea. Saa na na wɔyɛ no da biara, na wɔboaboaa sika bebree ano. Na ɔhene ne Yehoiada de maa wɔn a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie som adwuma no, na wɔde bobɔɔ aboɔpaefoɔ ne adwumfoɔ paa sɛ wɔnsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ, ne dadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adwumfoɔ nso, sɛ wɔmmiamia AWURADE fie no mu. Na wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no yɛe, na pempam adwuma no kɔɔ so wɔn nsam, na wɔde Nyankopɔn fie no sii hɔ maa no yɛɛ yie na ɛyɛɛ den. Na wɔwieeɛ no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ baa ɔhene ne Yehoiada anim, na wɔde yɛɛ nnoɔma maa AWURADE fie, ɔsom ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho nnoɔma ne nkoraa ne sika ne dwetɛ nnoɔma no. Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie daa daa Yehoiada berɛ so nyinaa.
Na Yehoiada bɔɔ akora, na wanyini pa ara no, ɔwui. Na ɔwuiɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha aduasa. Na wɔkɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu, ahemfo no nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii asɛmpa Israel ne Onyankopɔn ne ne fie no ho.

Na Yehoiada wuo akyiri no, Yuda mmapɔmma ba bɛkotoo ɔhene no. Ɛnna ɔhene no tiee wɔn. Na wɔgyaa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn fie, na wɔkɔsomm Asera nnua ne ahoni no. Na wɔn asodie yi nti abufuo baa Yuda ne Yerusalem so. Na ɔsomaa adiyifoɔ maa wɔbaa wɔn mu sɛ wɔmmɛsane wɔn mmra AWURADE nkyɛn, na wɔdii wɔn adanseɛ, nanso wɔantie.

Sɛ moagya AWURADE yi, ɔno nso agya mo. Na wɔpam ne tiri so, na wɔkɔsii no aboɔ, sɛdeɛ ɔhene hyɛeɛ no AWURADE fie abannwa so. Na Ɔhene Yoas ankae adɔeɛ a Sakaria agya Yehoiada de yɛɛ no no, na ɔkumm ne ba no. Na ɔrewuo no, ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE nhwɛ na ɔntɔ so were.

Na ne mma no ne ɛtoɔ dodoɔ a wɔgyee no no, ne Nyankopɔn fie asiesie no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Ahemfo Nwoma Nkyerɛaseɛ no mu. Na ne ba Amasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
